description: A formal insider threat program to detect and prevent malicious insider activity is not established. This signal indicates that insider threats may not be systematically detected or addressed.
applicability: Applicable to Level 3 environments with insider threat concerns. Includes insider threat detection, user behavior monitoring, and insider threat investigations.

metadata.detection_notes: Detected through insider threat program review, UBA deployment verification, and investigation process assessment.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 - System and Communications Protection
